COD.note: Only a civil-society call for public ownership of data and published contract; no government goal, rule, hosting or contract data terms stated.
ACEDH calls for public consultations; no online channel or government request for views online is stated.

facts.fact: ACP, reporting a communique by the rights group ACEDH, describes RDC-PASS as the national digital identification system whose deployment, under a 20-year, USD 97.1 million public-private contract with Trident Digital Tech Holdings, ACEDH asks to suspend.

systems.owner: Government with Trident Digital Tech Holdings (PPP)

COD.note: The PPP contract amount is given but no signing date and no statement that the private partner puts that sum in.

facts.fact: ACEDH says rural communities, indigenous peoples and defenders were not consulted on the RDC-PASS digital identification project and that public information and citizen participation are lacking.
